raw.body:
Thank you for getting back to me.

Unfortunately, I do not have a GSA link. I attempted to submit both reports through Meta's bug bounty portal, but the submission repeatedly failed when I clicked the submit button, so the reports were never successfully created in the bug bounty system.

As an alternative, I submitted two issues through GitHub Security Advisories. I have also added you as a coordinator so that you should be able to access the reports.

If you have a moment, I would greatly appreciate it if you could review the following advisories:
https://github.com/facebook/react/security/advisories/GHSA-w744-hqxh-xq3g
https://github.com/facebook/react/security/advisories/GHSA-25gh-ffm4-qc46

If there are any issues accessing them, or if you would prefer that I submit the reports through another channel, please let me know and I would be happy to do so.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

@rickhanlonii
